## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX neutral (VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY) and Stocks vs Bonds neutral (SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION / TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND) — breadth buoying markets despite neutral risk signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit conditions flat: HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND show no clear easing. Commodities/industrial demand supporting cyclicals via CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND; fear metrics neutral.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY/TLT mixed with SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%), while credit proxies HYG/LQD are BELOW TREND — subtle tightening without a clear risk-off move.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; Tech lagging with XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND. Style: Value/cyclicals showing strength vs Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed with SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%); China outperforming on the month with FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND while EM (EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY) remains uneven.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION shows crypto interest; ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND signals thematic/speculative weakness and IWM (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -2.01%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity bid: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND and metals GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND / SLV (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND — industrial reflationary signals intact.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy constructive: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND while natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND — oil/commodity complex stronger than gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Breadth (10/11) plus commodity and energy strength (CPER, XLE) support cyclicals; Major divergence: Tech/semis weakness — XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND — a material style split that keeps the overall signal neutral.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity-linked exposures (XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak tech/thematics (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND); bonds neutral given mixed TLT/HYG signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Industrials/XLE — XLI-like industrial strength (Industrials (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND) and XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech/thematics — XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and PDBC (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +9.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND and tactical thematic commodity corrections like BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX ~20 for complacency, HYG/LQD divergence around prior spread bands (~0.80 area) for credit stress, and XLK/ XLF cross (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND) as a growth vs value pivot signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, confirmed by neutral VXX and neutral SPY/TLT signals. Cyclicals and commodities showing strength (XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND; CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND) while Tech is the main weakness to monitor (XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; QQQ (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND).
